climate.note: Converged on all six criteria. The biosphere is assumed, not modelled, and that assumption is worth 3.7 to 7.1 K.

method.open_water_evaporation: Penman combination, water albedo and roughness, floored at the model's land rate
method.retain_tolerance_rationale: fractional change in open-water evaporation that would flip the verdict; 0.25 is set by the assumed-biosphere uncertainty, which dominates Penman's own 1.7%
